About

Hey, I'm Sayan

I'm Sayan Mandal, Co-Founder & Operations Partner at We Digital Mitra — an AI-powered digital marketing and automation agency serving local businesses.

My side of the agency is the ground game: meeting local businesses in person, building and maintaining our local network, and making sure day-to-day operations run smoothly. I'm based in Panbari Bazar, Maynaguri, in the Jalpaiguri district of West Bengal — the same ground our clients work on.
